based_on: Adapted from ISACA IS Audit / CISA Change Management guidance and NIST 800-53 CM family (for portfolio/demo use only — not an official framework export)

controls.title: Formal Change Request Process
controls.description: All changes to production systems must be submitted through a documented change request that captures requester, business justification, and affected systems.
controls.test_procedure: Confirm the policy defines a required change request form/ticket and that it is mandatory for all production changes, not just 'major' ones.

controls.title: Risk Assessment Prior to Change
controls.description: Each proposed change must be assessed for risk/impact before approval, including identification of affected systems and potential business disruption.
controls.test_procedure: Confirm the policy requires a documented risk or impact assessment step prior to approval, not just after implementation.

controls.title: Segregation of Duties
controls.description: The person who develops or requests a change must not be the same person who approves it or migrates it to production.
controls.test_procedure: Confirm the policy explicitly prohibits the same individual from requesting, approving, and implementing a change (look for named separate roles).

controls.title: Testing Prior to Production Deployment
controls.description: Changes must be tested in a non-production environment before deployment to production.
controls.test_procedure: Confirm the policy requires test/QA environment sign-off before production migration.

controls.title: Documented Rollback / Backout Plan
controls.description: Every change must have a documented rollback plan in case the change fails or causes unintended issues.
controls.test_procedure: Confirm the policy requires a rollback/backout plan to be documented and approved as part of the change record, not left to the implementer's discretion.

controls.title: Emergency Change Process
controls.description: A defined, expedited process exists for emergency changes, including retroactive approval and post-implementation review.
controls.test_procedure: Confirm the policy defines what qualifies as an emergency change, who can authorize expedited changes, and requires retroactive documentation/approval within a set timeframe.

controls.title: Change Advisory Board (CAB) Review
controls.description: Significant or high-risk changes are reviewed by a cross-functional change advisory board before approval.
controls.test_procedure: Confirm the policy defines criteria for CAB review and names who sits on the board.

controls.title: Post-Implementation Review
controls.description: Changes are reviewed after implementation to confirm they achieved the intended result without unintended side effects.
controls.test_procedure: Confirm the policy requires a post-implementation check-in and documentation of the outcome.

controls.title: Change Log / Audit Trail Retention
controls.description: A complete log of all changes (requested, approved, implemented, by whom, when) is retained for audit purposes.
controls.test_procedure: Confirm the policy specifies a retention period and that logs capture who approved and who implemented each change.
